import FreeCAD
import Part

# Open the precondition document
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

# Get the two sketch objects
sketch_a = doc.getObject("Sketch")
sketch_b = doc.getObject("Sketch001")

print(f"Sketch A edges: {sketch_a.Shape.Edges}")
print(f"Sketch B edges: {sketch_b.Shape.Edges}")

# Extract the edges from each sketch
edge_a = sketch_a.Shape.Edges[0]
edge_b = sketch_b.Shape.Edges[0]

print(f"\nEdge A: Start={edge_a.Vertexes[0].Point}, End={edge_a.Vertexes[1].Point}")
print(f"Edge B: Start={edge_b.Vertexes[0].Point}, End={edge_b.Vertexes[1].Point}")

# Create a ruled surface between the two edges
ruled_surface = Part.RuledSurface(edge_a, edge_b)
print(f"\nRuled surface created: {ruled_surface}")

# Create a shape from the ruled surface
surface_shape = ruled_surface.shape()
print(f"Surface shape type: {surface_shape.ShapeType}")

# Add the ruled surface to the document as a Part::Feature
part_feature = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "RuledSurface")
part_feature.Shape = surface_shape

# Recompute the document
doc.recompute()

print("\nDocument recompute completed.")

    print(f"  - {obj.Name}: {obj.TypeId}")

print("\nDocument saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
